Godey's Course of Lessons in Drawing. New Revelations of an Old Country. Ladies' Dresses and Diagrams. Dice Pattern for Slippers.

arxiv-2104-01420.title: A Design Process of Visual Analytics Application using Conceptual Graph
arxiv-2104-01420.creator: Lei Shi Beihang University
arxiv-2104-01420.description: Abstract State-of-the-art visual analytics techniques in application domains are often designed by VA professionals over qualitative requirement collected from end users. These VA techniques may not leverage users’ domain knowledge about how to achieve their analytical goals. In this position paper, we propose a user-driven design process of VA applications centered around a new concept called analytical representation (AR).

arxiv-2105-11103.title: Dissecting Click Fraud Autonomy in the Wild Conference: Proceedings of the 2021 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security; November 15–19, 2021; Virtual Event, Republic of Korea Proceedings of the 2021 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS ’21), Novem
arxiv-2105-11103.creator: Tong Zhu, Yan Meng, Haotian Hu, Xiaokuan Zhang, Minhui Xue, Haojin Zhu
arxiv-2105-11103.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tong Zhu, Yan Meng, Haotian Hu, Xiaokuan Zhang, Minhui Xue, Haojin Zhu. Although the use of pay-per-click mechanisms stimulates the prosperity of the mobile advertisement network, fraudulent ad clicks result in huge financial losses for advertisers. Extensive studies identify click fraud according to click/traffic patterns based on dynamic analysis. However, in this study, we identify a novel click fraud, named humanoid attack , which can circumvent existing detection schemes by generating fraudulent clicks with similar patterns to normal clicks.

arxiv-2108-10963.title: Perspectives on the Calibration of CNN Energy Reconstruction in Highly Granular Calorimeters
arxiv-2108-10963.creator: N. Akchurin, C. Cowden, J. Damgov, A. Hussain, S. Kunori
arxiv-2108-10963.description: Abstract We present a study which shows encouraging stability of the response linearity for a simulated high granularity calorimeter module reconstructed by a CNN model to miscalibration, bias, and noise effects. Our results also show an intuitive, quantifiable relationship between these factors and the calibration parameters.

arxiv-2201-13407.title: Binary superradiance: a numerical study
arxiv-2201-13407.creator: Diogo C. Ribeiro, Miguel Zilhão, Vitor Cardoso
arxiv-2201-13407.description: Abstract Rotating axisymmetric objects amplify incoming waves by superradiant scattering. When enclosed in a cavity, the repeated interaction of a confined field with the object may trigger superradiant instabilities. Rotating binaries are ubiquitous in physics, and play a fundamental role in astrophysics and in everyday life instruments.

arxiv-2202-10852.title: A pathwise parameterisation for stochastic transport
arxiv-2202-10852.creator: Oana Lang, Wei Pan
arxiv-2202-10852.description: Abstract In this work we set the stage for a new probabilistic pathwise approach to effectively calibrate a general class of stochastic nonlinear fluid dynamics models. We focus on a 2D Euler SALT equation, showing that the driving stochastic parameter can be calibrated in an optimal way to match a set of given data.

arxiv-2205-15126.title: Elastic Monte Carlo Tree Search with State Abstraction for Strategy Game Playing
arxiv-2205-15126.creator: Linjie Xu, Jorge Hurtado-Grueso, Dominic Jeurissen and Diego Perez Liebana, Alexander Dockhorn
arxiv-2205-15126.description: Abstract Strategy video games challenge AI agents with their combinatorial search space caused by complex game elements. State abstraction is a popular technique that reduces the state space complexity. However, current state abstraction methods for games depend on domain knowledge, making their application to new games expensive.

arxiv-2211-12050.title: Modeling Resources in Permissionless Longest-chain Total-order Broadcast
arxiv-2211-12050.creator: Sarah Azouvi, Christian Cachin, Duc V. Le, Marko Vukolić, Luca Zanolini
arxiv-2211-12050.description: Abstract Blockchain protocols implement total-order broadcast in a permissionless setting, where processes can freely join and leave. In such a setting, to safeguard against Sybil attacks, correct processes rely on cryptographic proofs tied to a particular type of resource to make them eligible to order transactions.

arxiv-2411-10432.title: Superconnections in AdS/QCD and the hadronic light-by-light contribution to the muon g − 2 g-2
arxiv-2411-10432.creator: Josef Leutgeb, Jonas Mager, Anton Rebhan
arxiv-2411-10432.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider hard-wall AdS/QCD models extended by a string-theory inspired Chern-Simons action in terms of a superconnection involving a bi-fundamental scalar field which corresponds to the open-string tachyon of brane-antibrane configurations and which is naturally identified with the holographic dual of the quark condensate in chiral symmetry breaking.

arxiv-2506-11456.title: Fast Bayesian Optimization of Function Networks with Partial Evaluations
arxiv-2506-11456.creator: Poompol Buathong pb482@cornell.edu, Peter I. Frazier pf98@cornell.edu
arxiv-2506-11456.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization of function networks (BOFN) is a framework for optimizing expensive-to-evaluate objective functions structured as networks, where some nodes’ outputs serve as inputs for others. Many real-world applications, such as manufacturing and drug discovery, involve function networks with additional properties – nodes that can be evaluated independently and incur varying costs.

arxiv-2507-08532.title: A thermonuclear supernova interacting with hydrogen- and helium-deficient circumstellar material
arxiv-2507-08532.creator: K. Tsalapatas, J. Sollerman, R. Chiba, E. Kool, J. Johansson, S. Rosswog, S. Schulze, T. J. Moriya, I. Andreoni, T. G. Brink, T. X. Chen, S. Covarrubias, K. De, G. Dimitriadis, A. V. Filippenko, C. Fremling, A. Gangopadhyay, K. Maguire, G. Mo, Y. Sharma, N. Sravan, J. H. Terwel, Y. Yang
arxiv-2507-08532.description: Abstract Identifying the progenitors of thermonuclear supernovae (Type Ia supernovae; SNe Ia) remains a key objective in contemporary astronomy. The rare subclass of SNe Ia that interacts with circumstellar material (Type Ia-CSM) allows for studies of the progenitor’s environment before explosion, and generally favours single-degenerate progenitor channels.

arxiv-2510-08868.title: Accretion-Regulated Type Transitions in Changing-Look AGNs: Evidence from Two-Epoch Spectral Analysis
arxiv-2510-08868.creator: Yu-Heng Shen, Kai-Xing Lu, Wei-Jian Guo, Sha-Sha Li, Hai-Cheng Feng, Zhang Yue, Wen-Zhe Xi, Jian-Guo Wang, Jin-Ming Bai
arxiv-2510-08868.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu-Heng Shen, Kai-Xing Lu, Wei-Jian Guo, Sha-Sha Li, Hai-Cheng Feng, Zhang Yue, Wen-Zhe Xi, Jian-Guo Wang, Jin-Ming Bai. The changing-look active galactic nucleus (CL-AGN), an extraordinary subpopulation of supermassive black holes, has attracted growing attention for understanding its nature. We present an analysis of the spectral properties of 203 low-redshift CL-AGNs ( z < 0.35 z<0.35 ) using two-epoch spectra from SDSS DR16 and DESI DR1 with time baseline ranging from ∼ \sim 1000 to 8000 days, based on spectral fitting and decomposition.

arxiv-2602-19510.title: Less is More: Convergence Benefits of Fewer Data Weight Updates over Longer Horizon
arxiv-2602-19510.creator: Rudrajit Das, Neel Patel, Meisam Razaviyayn, Vahab Mirrokni
arxiv-2602-19510.description: Abstract Data mixing—the strategic reweighting of training domains—is a critical component in training robust machine learning models. This problem is naturally formulated as a bilevel optimization task, where the outer loop optimizes domain weights to minimize validation loss, and the inner loop optimizes model parameters to minimize the weighted training loss.

For instance, cancer is characterized by extensive ECM remodeling thanks to abnormal proteolytic enzyme activation; furthermore, altered ECM expression has been linked to tumor onset.

pmc-10619707.title: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis: Do We Still Need Microscope Surgery in Hepatic Artery Anastomosis to Decrease the Incidence of Complications in Living Donor Liver Transplantation?
pmc-10619707.creator: Beshoy Elkomos, Philopateer Alkomos, Rao Junaid Saleem, Guirgis Ebeidallah, Joseph Hanna, Amr Abdelaal
pmc-10619707.description: Hepatic artery thrombosis (HAT) is the most serious vascular complication after liver transplantation (LT). Moreover, in comparison to deceased donor liver transplantation (DDLT), hepatic artery (HA) anastomosis is more challenging in living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) with a lot of controversial topics about the use of microscopic surgery.

pmc-11476149.title: Clinical effect of psychological nursing and nutritional intervention in radiopharmaceutical therapy of patients with thyroid carcinoma
pmc-11476149.creator: Jing Chen, Yuanzheng Liu
pmc-11476149.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objective:To investigate the clinical value of psychological nursing and nutritional intervention in radiopharmaceutical therapy of patients with thyroid carcinoma.Methods:This was retrospective study. One hundred and twenty patients with thyroid carcinoma were included at Baoding No.1 Central Hospital from May 10, 2021 to July 10, 2023 to as subjects and randomly divided into the control group and the experimental group (n=60 each group).

pmc-11501070.title: Dual-control of incubation effect for efficiently fabricating surface structures in fused silica
pmc-11501070.creator: Zhi Wang, Zhikun Xiang, Xiaowei Li, Mengnan Wu, Peng Yi, Chao Zhang, Yihao Yan, Xibiao Li, Xiangyu Zhang, Andong Wang, Lingling Huang
pmc-11501070.description: Fused silica with surface structures has potential applications in microfluidic, aerospace and other fields. To fabricate structures with high dimensional accuracy and surface quality is of paramount importance. However, it is indeed a challenge to strike a balance between accuracy and efficiency at the same time.

pmc-12645025.title: Associations of oral hypoglycemic use, fruit intake, and diabetes duration with gastrointestinal autonomic dysfunction in type 2 diabetes patients in Zanzibar
pmc-12645025.creator: Hassan Thabit Haji, Ashabilan Ebrahim, Ahmed Gharib Khamis, Ramla Muhidin Ali, Kaushik Ramaiya, Fredirick L Mashili
pmc-12645025.description: Background Gastrointestinal autonomic dysfunction (GAD) is a common complication of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) leading to gastroparesis, constipation, and gastroesophageal reflux disease, consequently affecting the overall quality of life. However, its prevalence and risk factors remain underexplored, particularly in low-resource settings like Zanzibar.

pmc-12659037.title: Predictive role of geriatric nutritional risk index for postoperative complications in operated esophageal cancer patients: a meta-analysis
pmc-12659037.creator: Long Tian, Yijie Bu, Yao Wang, Yan Wang, Guowei Che
pmc-12659037.description: PurposeTo determine the association between preoperative geriatric nutritional risk index (GNRI) and postoperative complications in surgical esophageal cancer patients.MethodsPubMed, Web of Science EMBASE and CNKI databases were searched from inception up to December 16, 2024. Primary outcome was the overall complication.

pmc-12682284.title: A mathematical model for the co-activation of inflammatory genes mediated by NF-κB and IRF-3 following viral infections
pmc-12682284.creator: Syona Tiwari, Rajiv Kumar Mishra, Soumen Basak, Rakesh Pandey
pmc-12682284.description: SummaryThe innate immune responses in host cells are activated through molecular signaling pathways, such as NF-κB and IRF-3 in response to viral infections. These transcription factors regulate the expression of antiviral genes that encode type I interferons (IFNα/β). However, the precise mechanism that governs their complex context-dependent temporal activation remains elusive.

pmc-13171893.title: Expanded iOn switch toolkit enables flexible clonal labeling and dynamic imaging in model and non-model animals
pmc-13171893.creator: Zi Chao Ngiam, Kyosuke Wada, Jun Hatakeyama, Yuki Y Yamauchi, Takuya Kaneko, Pauline Rouillard, Haruka Sato, Masahiko Hibi, Ikuo K Suzuki, Carina Hanashima, Chiaki Ohtaka-Maruyama, Takuma Kumamoto
pmc-13171893.description: Understanding how neural progenitors generate diverse neuronal subtypes is central to developmental and evolutionary neuroscience. Lineage tracing is a key tool for dissecting these processes, but existing methods are often constrained by stochastic expression, recombination bias, or reliance on transgenic models—limitations that restrict their application in non-model organisms. Here, we present an enhanced iOn switch system optimized for evo-devo research.

pmc-13257096.title: Structure–Activity Relationship of Flavonol O-Methylation Revealed by In Vitro, In Silico and Zebrafish Neurodegeneration Models
pmc-13257096.creator: Kamila Borowiec, Agnieszka Michalak, Katarzyna Targowska-Duda
pmc-13257096.description: Flavonols are dietary polyphenols whose biological activity is influenced by structural modifications such as O-methylation. This study compared two quercetin derivatives, isorhamnetin (3′-O-methylquercetin) and rhamnetin (7-O-methylquercetin). Antioxidant activity was evaluated using 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH), 2,2′-azinobis-(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulphonic acid) (ABTS), cupric reducing antioxidant capacity (CUPRAC), and ferric reducing antioxidant power (FRAP) assays.

pmc-13380107.title: Family screening for abdominal aortic aneurysms: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13380107.creator: Leonardo Buttice, Jonathan JH Bray, Claire E Foster-Archibald, Sophie E Thompson, Dominic Howard, Alex Pitcher
pmc-13380107.description: SummaryBackgroundInternational guidelines recommend screening of first-degree relatives of patients with abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA). However, the prevalence of AAA amongst screened relatives is uncertain.MethodsMedline, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception to 4 March 2026 for studies screening relatives of patients with AAA. Data were analysed using a random-effects model meta-analysis in Stata.

pmc-13424621.title: Stabilization of Niaouli essential oil-loaded gelatin nanofibers: characterization and in vitro evaluation
pmc-13424621.creator: Kübra Arancı, Sema Nur Yıldırım, Elif İlhan, Sümeyra Ayan, Sevgi Gülyüz, Oğuzhan Gündüz, Özgür Yılmaz
pmc-13424621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Niaouli essential oil (NEO), obtained from Melaleuca quinquenervia leaves, is a plant-derived active compound with high biological activity properties; however, its direct use is limited due to its hydrophobicity, volatility, and instability. In this study, biologically active and mechanically enhanced nanofiber-based drug delivery systems were developed by directly incorporating NEO into gelatin (G)-based electrospun nanofibers and enhancing their stability through chemical crosslinking with glutaraldehyde (GTA) vapor.

pmc-13425477.title: Scalable and Systematical Conversions of Domestic Wastes to Core–Sheath Nanofibers for Photocatalytic Degradation of Antibiotics
pmc-13425477.creator: Ran Dong, Yingao Ru, Xinyi Zhang, Jiaqi Zhu, Haifeng Wen, Daihua He, Deng-Guang Yu
pmc-13425477.description: Batch nanofabrication of complex nanostructures remains a critical challenge, restricting their translation from laboratory design to industrial application. To address this, we report a conceptual and methodological advance by developing a brand-new “needle-confined region free-surface” triaxial electrospinning process. In a unique waste-to-resource concept, discarded polyethylene terephthalate (PET) beverage bottles were innovatively converted into the multifluid spinneret.

pmc-13559396.title: The expert consensus document on minimally invasive upper lobectomy for lung cancer in China
pmc-13559396.creator: Licheng Wu, Longyong Mei, Jinbo Zhao, Cheng Shen, Wei Wu, Shiguang Xu, Yuchi Xiu, Wenzhou Liu, Guangqiang Zhao, Zhiqiang Xue, Dong Xie, Liang Xie, Haitao Huang, Naixin Liang, Lei Xian, Bo Deng
pmc-13559396.description: BackgroundMinimally invasive upper lobectomy is recognized as a standard surgical intervention for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Nevertheless, there is a paucity of evidence-based technical standards regarding anatomical sequences, the scope of lymphadenectomy, and perioperative management in the context of upper lobectomy.MethodsA multidisciplinary team comprising thoracic surgeons from 12 tertiary centers across China was assembled.
